review_evidence: README states that this library contains the formal proof of the Four Color Theorem together with classical-real, plane-topology and combinatorial-hypermap theories needed for the result.

All 119 primary Coq files were inventoried: 118 own common declaration forms, totaling about 3,037 declarations. theories/proof/fourcolor.v proves `four_color_finite` and `four_color`; configurations.v, cfmap.v, geometry.v and the real-number modules are declaration-dense supporting developments.
The only declaration-light primary module, theories/reals/realsyntax.v, is part of the real-number interface and was not proven disposable independently of the retained development.
summary: Retain the full Four Color Theorem formalization and its supporting real/topological/hypermap theory; no safe source-local exclusion was established.
